about: What a .docx written by particle-academy/last-word cannot express, and why. Each entry has a kind: "format" when no .docx can hold it, "writer" when Word can save it and last-word does not write it yet (Fancy's corrected parity matrix, .ai/plans/docx-parity-matrix.md in the prism envelope, 2026-11-21). A writer limit's statement never says Word or the format cannot do it: it says this writer does not do it yet, and the message offers the closest option. Each entry quotes the last-word source that states it; tests/LimitsCatalogTest.php fails when a quote is no longer in the installed last-word, so a limit last-word lifts, or rewords, cannot linger here unnoticed. The statement and alternatives are what the person is told, so they are plain words.

limits.statement: This writer does not yet let the header or footer reach past the side margins while the body keeps them.
limits.appliesWhen: The request asks for the header or footer to use different left or right margins from the body: no margins for the header only, header art edge to edge while the body keeps its margins, a wider footer.
alternatives: Set the side margins to zero for the whole page, so the header art runs edge to edge and the body text does too.
Keep the header art inside the page margins, as it is now.

limits.council: Fancy CC-fancy-0055 (anchored and floating pictures), first in Fancy's gap order, closes this. Word can: an anchored picture placed relative to the page, or a negative indent. last-word writes every picture inline, inside the margins.

limits.statement: This writer does not yet let a picture or other block run past the page margins to the edge of the page.
limits.appliesWhen: The request asks for a picture, band or block to bleed off the page, run to the page edge, or sit partly in the margin, while the margins stay.
alternatives: Set the page margins to zero, so the picture can reach the edge of the page.
Keep the picture inside the margins at the full width of the text.
limits.applied: As you asked, the page margins are zero, so the body text reaches the edge of the page as well as the picture.
limits.council: Fancy CC-fancy-0055 (anchored and floating pictures, bleed included), first in Fancy's gap order, closes this. Until it lands, the writer caps every picture at the text column.

limits.council: A format limit, as Fancy's corrected matrix keeps it: a page break has no meaning in a header or footer. A chart in one would be a writer gap only if Word accepts one, which is still unverified (an open check for Fancy); re-label it then.
limits.statement: A header or footer cannot hold a chart or a page break.
limits.appliesWhen: The request asks for a chart, or a page break, inside the header or footer.
alternatives: Put the chart in the body, at the top of the first page.
Put the figure in the header as a picture instead of a chart.

limits.council: A format limit, as Fancy's corrected matrix keeps it: Word does not offer a footnote in a header, and a footnote inside a footnote has no reference mechanism. Unverified in Word itself (an open check for Fancy).
limits.statement: A header or footer cannot hold a footnote, and a footnote cannot hold another footnote.
limits.appliesWhen: The request asks for a footnote in the header or footer, or a footnote on a footnote.
alternatives: Put the note in the body text, as a footnote on the first page.
Write the note into the header or footer as plain small text.

sources.quote: but not inside another footnote and not in a header or footer

limits.statement: This writer does not yet give some pages a different background from the rest.
limits.appliesWhen: The request asks for a different page background on some pages or after a page break.
alternatives: Use one page colour for the whole document.
Shade the paragraphs or table on those pages instead of the page.

sources.quote: `page.background` on a break is refused: Word has one page colour per document.
'properties' => array_diff_key($pageProps, ['background' => true]),

limits.council: Fancy gap order item 11 (watermarks and per-section backgrounds, built on CC-fancy-0055). One page colour per document is the format's (w:background); a different background on some pages is a full-page shape behind the text, which Word can save and last-word does not write yet.

limits.statement: This writer does not yet place pictures other than PNG or JPEG, such as SVG, GIF or EMF.
limits.appliesWhen: The request asks to place a picture that is not PNG or JPEG.
alternatives: Convert the picture to PNG and place that.

sources.quote: A header or footer image, whether an agent wrote it or `read()` took it from an upload, must be PNG or JPEG by its leading bytes as well as its type
'description' => 'PNG or JPEG data URL.',

limits.council: Fancy gap order item 17 (image formats). A .docx carries GIF, BMP, TIFF, EMF and WMF, and SVG with a PNG fallback; PNG and JPEG only is last-word's hardening choice, and the owner decides which formats are worth the parser surface.
